rationale.tooling-supply-chain: Adversarial obfuscation systematically attacks LLM code-review agents.
rationale.ai-review: Experiments expose transferable reliability failures in CoT-based AI vulnerability judgments.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Generated obfuscations substantially evade evaluated static security analyzers.
rationale.framework: Reusable multi-agent attack pipeline integrates generation, verification, reflection, and search.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented and evaluated CoTDeceptor across models and vulnerability categories.
rationale.agentic: Autonomous multi-step agents produce complete obfuscated code artifacts for review.
rationale.steering: Core mechanism iteratively shapes malicious code generation using detector feedback.
rationale.metrics: Defines security measurands for evasion, hallucination, consistency, and transferability.
rationale.risk-security: Empirically demonstrates security-audit bypass across real vulnerability categories.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled attacks characterize third-party models, analyzers, and auditing agents.
